fields.value: From the creators of Clay Fighter comes a game about a shape-shifting ball of clay. You play as a boy named Clayton, whose father has developed a serum to turn humans into animals. However, an evil shaman desires this serum, and when he is denied ownership of it, he kidnaps Clayton's father and turns Clayton into a ball of clay. It's up to the unlikely hero to rescue his father, the serum, and the world!

De los creadores de Clay Fighter llega un juego sobre una bola de arcilla que cambia de forma. Juegas como un niño llamado Clayton, cuyo padre ha desarrollado un suero para convertir a los humanos en animales. Sin embargo, un chamán malvado desea este suero y, cuando se le niega su posesión, secuestra al padre de Clayton y convierte a Clayton en una bola de arcilla. ¡Depende del improbable héroe rescatar a su padre, el suero y el mundo!
